19/S0.subgoal: Explain the role of software in VR and AR as a driver for hardware to generate sensory experiences.

19/S1.subgoal: Describe the bidirectional data flow between the user, VR hardware, and software components in a VR system.

19/S2.subgoal: Identify the three core activities involved in creating a VR experience and distinguish between developer and user perspectives.

19/S3.subgoal: Compare the ideal developer experience with practical software realities involving SDKs and game engines.

19/S4.subgoal: Explain the concept of a Virtual World Generator (VWG) and the different methods for creating virtual environments.

19/S5.subgoal: Describe matched motion concepts, including matched zones, tracking, and locomotion methods to manage user experience and cyber-sickness.

19/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
